score_semantics.agent_fundamental_score: 1.0 means strongest point-in-time fundamental profile; 0.0 means weakest.
score_semantics.agent_risk_score: 1.0 means strongest downside resilience and lowest assessed risk; 0.0 means highest risk.
score_semantics.agent_catalyst_score: 1.0 means strongest verified positive catalyst profile; 0.0 means strongest negative catalyst profile.
score_semantics.agent_macro_fit_score: 1.0 means strongest fit with the documented macro and market regime.
score_semantics.agent_confidence: Confidence that the assessment is supported by the cited evidence.
